text: This solution, Greater Mekong Subregion Flood and Drought Risk Management and Mitigation Project (Cambodia component) addresses natural catastrophe in Cambodia between Ministry of Water Resources and Meteorology (MOWRAM), Department of Hydrology and River Works (DHRW), Provincial Department of Water Resources and Meteorology (Pursat), National Flood Forecasting Center (NFFC), Asian Development Bank (ADB), Strategic Climate Fund (SCF), and Greater Mekong Subregion Secretariat. The program was implemented in 2012 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
